methods.label: Use a multiplication fact
methods.explanation: \(4=2\times2\). In addition to 1 and 4, 4 also has 2 as a factor, so 4 is composite.
methods.levelReason: The calculation is a Grade 2 multiplication fact; the retained factor and composite-number discussion is within Grade 5.
